items.title: Big Apple blockbuster: Mets, Skubal reach record 9-year, $450M contract, sources say
items.summary: Tarik Skubal and the Mets agreed to a nine-year, $450 million contract, sources told ESPN. It is the richest deal for a pitcher, both by total and average annual value.

items.title: Sources: Yankees continue to strengthen bullpen, sign Suter to 1-year, $4M deal
items.summary: The Yankees and left-handed reliever Brent Suter are in agreement on a one-year, $4 million contract with a club option for 2028, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Monday.

items.title: Brewers receive full playoff share of $493,044; total pool down from 2025
items.summary: A full postseason share for the World Series champion Milwaukee Brewers was $493,044, and the total players' pool amount of roughly $114.5 million was down from the previous two seasons.

items.title: Sources: Tigers stay busy, add '24 AL Rookie of Year Gil to pitching mix
items.summary: Luis Gil and the Tigers are in agreement on a one-year, $2.3 million contract, sources told ESPN, as he lands a job just days after the Yankees nontendered him.

items.title: Mets, CF Ewing agree on 8-year, $95M extension, sources say
items.summary: The Mets and 22-year-old center fielder A.J. Ewing have agreed to an eight-year, $95 million contract extension, sources confirmed to ESPN.

items.title: Sources: Royals continue pitching makeover, sign Thielbar to 1-year deal
items.summary: The Royals signed left-hander Caleb Thielbar to a one-year, $3.25 million contract, sources told ESPN on Monday, as the club continues its offseason pitching staff makeover.

items.title: Source: Mets agree to 1-year deal with veteran 1B Goldschmidt
items.summary: The New York Mets continued their spending spree Monday by coming to terms on a one-year deal with first baseman Paul Goldschmidt, a source told ESPN, a day after agreeing to give Tarik Skubal the largest contract ever to a pitcher.
